newsitem.title: CHINA: China foreign debt up 9.0 pct to $116.28 bln.
newsitem.headline: China foreign debt up 9.0 pct to $116.28 bln.

text.p: China's foreign debt rose to $116.28 billion at the end of 1996, up by about 9.0 percent compared with a year ago, the State Administration of Foreign Exchange said in a report issued by the Xinhua news agency on Monday.
China's foreign debt increased by $9.69 billion last year, the administration said.
China's foreign debt at end-June was $109.57 billion.
China's debt-service ratio was 7.3 percent in 1995, well within the recognised safety level of 20 percent, state media has said.
China's current account was basically balanced in 1996 with a slight surplus, while its capital account saw a rather large surplus, the administration said without elaborating.
